finance.summary_cn: 财政部长斯科特·贝森特希望在不向敏感的美国债券市场出售国债的情况下捍卫日元。美联储可以提供帮助。

finance.title_cn: 吉姆·克莱默（Jim Cramer）表示，市场对大型科技公司的人工智能支出已经升温。这就是打开开关的原因
finance.summary_cn: 克莱默表示，亚马逊首席执行官安迪·贾西最终解释了亚马逊的大量人工智能支出将如何产生长期回报。

finance.title: Trump sours on Pirro over Reflecting Pool case, won't say her job is safe
finance.summary: President Donald Trump said Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for the District of Columbia, "choked" and "folded like an umbrella" in the Reflecting Pool case.

finance.summary_cn: 唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，哥伦比亚特区美国检察官珍妮·皮尔罗在反思池案中“哽咽”并“像雨伞一样折叠”。

finance.title: A trio of positive developments has Boeing shares soaring

ai.title: The AI Revolution Has a Leadership Challenge No Algorithm Can Solve
ai.description: New Delhi [India], August 3: Artificial intelligence has become the defining force behind today's business transformation. From streamlining operations and enhancing customer experiences to accelerating decision-making, AI is reshaping how organisations compete. Yet, amid this technological shift, one reality is becoming increasingly clear: the success of AI initiatives depends less on the technology itself and more on the quality of leadership behind it.
ai.title_cn: 人工智能革命面临着无法解决的领导力挑战
ai.description_cn: 新德里[印度]，8月3日：人工智能已成为当今商业转型背后的决定性力量。从简化运营、增强客户体验到加速决策，人工智能正在重塑组织的竞争方式。然而，在这种技术变革中，一个现实变得越来越清晰：人工智能计划的成功与其说取决于技术本身，不如说取决于技术背后的领导力质量。

ai.title: BHIO launches AI-powered MRI system, announces four-week free scanning
ai.description: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) system, marking a significant advancement in diagnostic healthcare.
ai.title_cn: BHIO推出人工智能MRI系统，宣布为期四周免费扫描
ai.description_cn: 人工智能（AI）驱动的磁共振成像（MRI）系统，标志着诊断医疗保健的重大进步。

ai.title: Is AI harmful? Europe enacts a new AI Act provision to protect users
ai.description: From heightened stress responses to subtle manipulation, experts say AI's hidden health risks are only beginning to emerge. The EU Artificial Intelligence Act — the world's first comprehensive AI law — has been phased in since 2024. And a major provision took effect yesterday, August 2, applying rules to high-risk AI systems used in regulated products such as medical devices, machinery and toys.
ai.title_cn: 人工智能有害吗？欧洲颁布新的人工智能法案条款以保护用户
ai.description_cn: 从高度的压力反应到微妙的操纵，专家表示，人工智能隐藏的健康风险才刚刚开始显现。《欧盟人工智能法案》是世界上第一部全面的人工智能法律，自2024年起逐步实施。8月2日，一项重要条款生效，将规则适用于医疗设备、机械和玩具等受监管产品中使用的高风险人工智能系统。

ai.title: Malaysia, Cambodia to strengthen cooperation across various sectors, says Anwar
ai.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia and Cambodia have reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening strategic cooperation across various sectors, including the digital economy, artificial intelligence (AI), the halal industry, food security and human capital development, says Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim.
ai.title_cn: 安瓦尔说，马来西亚，柬埔寨将加强各部门的合作
ai.description_cn: 吉隆坡：马来西亚和柬埔寨重申致力于加强各领域的战略合作，包括数字经济，人工智能（AI），清真产业，粮食安全和人力资本发展，拿督斯里安瓦尔易卜拉欣说。

ai.title: New tool enables early intervention for diabetes related foot ulcers
ai.description: A collaborative project between the University of Melbourne and RMIT has developed a thermal-imaging artificial intelligence (AI) tool called THERMUL to prevent diabetes-related foot ulcer hospitalizations and amputations by improving early intervention rates.
ai.title_cn: 新工具能够早期干预糖尿病相关的足溃疡
ai.description_cn: 墨尔本大学和皇家理工学院之间的一个合作项目开发了一种名为THERMUL的热成像人工智能（AI）工具，通过提高早期干预率来预防与糖尿病相关的足溃疡住院和截肢。
